entities.summary: Serge Lutens is a French fashion designer, perfume creator, photographer, filmmaker and hair stylist. He is known principally for the fashion house and fragrance company which bears his name. The company's best-selling fragrances are Datura Noir, Tubereuse Criminelle, Dent de Lait, Un Bois Vanille, Ambre Sultan, Five O Clock Au Gingembre, Fille en Aiguilles, Nuit de Cellophane, Jeux de Peau, Fleurs de Citronnier, Santal Majuscule.
